description: This file defines a PrometheusServicesLogger class for monitoring and logging service metrics (latency, request counts, sizes) for litellm and related services, integrating with Prometheus client library.

classes.name: PrometheusServicesLogger
classes.description: A class for initializing and managing Prometheus metrics for various services, including methods for creating metrics, checking registration, and updating metrics on service success or failure.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Prometheus client, sets up metrics for each service based on configuration, and prepares internal mappings.

methods.name: _get_service_metrics_initialize
methods.description: Retrieves the list of metrics to initialize for a given service, defaulting to counter and histogram.

methods.name: is_metric_registered
methods.description: Checks if a metric with the given name is already registered in the Prometheus registry.

methods.name: _get_metric
methods.description: Fetches a metric object from the registry by name.

methods.name: create_histogram
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a histogram metric for a service and request type.

methods.name: create_gauge
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a gauge metric for a service and request type.

methods.name: create_counter
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a counter metric for a service and request type, with optional additional labels.

methods.name: observe_histogram
methods.description: Records an observation in a histogram metric.

methods.name: update_gauge
methods.description: Sets the value of a gauge metric.

methods.name: increment_counter
methods.description: Increments a counter metric by a specified amount, with optional additional labels.

methods.name: service_success_hook
methods.description: Logs a successful service call, updating relevant metrics.

methods.name: service_failure_hook
methods.description: Logs a failed service call, updating relevant metrics.

methods.name: async_service_success_hook
methods.description: Asynchronous version of success hook for logging successful calls.

methods.name: async_service_failure_hook
methods.description: Asynchronous version of failure hook for logging failed calls, including error details.
